## {{< fa box-open title="an open box" >}} Required Packages {#pkgs}

We'll be using the following R packages: 

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| echo: true
#| code-line-numbers: false
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(shinyWidgets)
library(shinycssloaders)
library(markdown)
library(rsconnect)
```

## {{< fa table title="a data table" >}} Required Data {#data}

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| echo: true
#| code-line-numbers: false
library(palmerpenguins)
library(lterdatasampler)
```
